data.narrative:
Tytan Technologies is a Series A–stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security that has raised €30M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach. The 10-company peer set spans a valuation range of $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B. Sampled peers in the Series B stage include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B. This median reflects market pricing for growth-stage defenstech and security software firms with meaningful traction and customer adoption.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with $1.0B as the median point. This single-method framework carries inherent limitations: peer valuations reflect heterogeneous funding rounds, growth profiles, and revenue scales, and the Series A / Series B boundary introduces stage-related spread. Key uncertainties include Tytan's revenue run rate, customer concentration, and go-to-market momentum relative to the B-stage cohort. Upside or downside adjustments would require visibility into unit economics and defensible IP positioning within the broader Defense & Security ecosystem.
